evidence: Touches TxDownloadManager orphan resolution and transaction download logic in src/node/txdownloadman_impl.cpp with P2P label.
rationale: Fixes a relay liveness edge case where orphan resolution requests for non-witness transactions are prematurely forgotten. Because wtxid equals txid for non-witness parents rejected as TX_RECONSIDERABLE, forgetting the wtxid inadvertently cancels queued txid requests to orphan announcers, leaving the child stuck in the orphanage.
